title: Fear does not get the last word
summary: Guru meets wavering by reminding you whose care has carried you from the start.
takeaway: The One who made you has not stepped back from you.
lifeApplication: When fear spikes, repeat the line before you plan the entire future.

source.shortMeaning: The Creator who formed you remains your support.
source.lifeApplication: Answer fear with remembrance before strategy.

evidence.coreClaim: The Creator who formed you remains your support.
evidence.turn: The answer to fear is not bravado. It is remembrance of the One already holding you.
evidence.practicalImplication: When fear spikes, repeat the line before you plan the entire future.
